title: Design: Bill To list opens with this customer first then customers A to Z
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have customer B with no saved Bill Invoices To and at least 10 other customers.
  • Have a new open work order for this test for customer B (an Estimate is fine) that bills itself, so its Bill To reads This customer.
  • Start on the work order page.
  • Open the attached picture bt-p2-03-after-open.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps: 1. Click the Bill To field on the customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The field shows a border, "This customer" selected and an up arrow.
  • A list opens; its first row reads "[customer B's name] (this customer)" in blue on a light blue background.
  • The rows after it are customers in A to Z order; the Counter Sale customer is not among them.
  • The list is drawn wider than the card, as in the picture.

Words in square brackets stand for the value they name, such as customer A's name exactly as it is saved.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page), story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R3: “Typing searches every customer in the organization except Counter Sale, A to Z, showing the first 50 matches; the first option is always "[customer] (this customer)".”
  • S1-N5: “Counter Sale never appears in the field's options.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "2 Bill a work order or part sale to someone else", pictures "Open" (This build).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p2-03-after-open.png

The design's own words:

  • “Never Counter Sale.”
  • “The list holds the first 50 customers A to Z; typing narrows it.”

Difference: the list opens above the field and covers the cards and the lines table edge (BT-D09, question 9).
